intro.t1_text: Night of November 22–23, 2023. Viktor Sokolov, the owner of the local café, is murdered in his own home. A knife wound. The killer left no trace.
intro.t2_text: A private detective. You have a rare gift: you can travel back in time to the very same places — and see what has already vanished. The city gave you seven days. If the case is not solved, it will be closed forever.
intro.t3_text: Inspect everything, talk to witnesses, keep your notebook. If clues have disappeared — go back in time (key Q) and find them there. But remember: time in the city keeps flowing, and it does not wait.
intro.t4_text: Day 1. 06:00. Time to get to work.

tut.move: Move with WASD or arrow keys. Shift — run (it tires you faster).
tut.interact: Walk up to an object and press E to inspect or interact.
tut.time: Press Q — the time travel window opens. You can go into the past and see the city as it was.
tut.time_hint: In the past, objects, clues and people change. Meanwhile the present keeps moving on.
tut.notebook: The notebook (key J) stores clues, witness statements and postcards.
tut.wardrobe: Wardrobe: press E to get dressed. Gloves keep you from ruining evidence.
tut.dress_done: You are dressed. Now leave the house — the city is waiting.
tut.bed: The bed relieves fatigue. The more tired you are — the longer you sleep. Collapse from exhaustion and you will sleep 16 hours.
tut.fatigue: Watch the fatigue bar. Heavy fatigue slows you down, full fatigue knocks you out on the spot.
tut.hunger: You are hungry. Food can be bought at the shop. Without food, Mike won't last long.
tut.shop: Shop: food, coffee and medicine are sold here.
tut.bank: Bank: you can take a loan here. In 3 days you must repay 25% more. Fail — and your apartment is taken away.
tut.gloves: You are not wearing gloves! Get dressed at the wardrobe first — or you will ruin the evidence.
tut.utilities: Every day (except the first), $30 for utilities is charged at the end of the day.
tut.news: Every evening — the city news. Your results affect the public support.
tut.save: You can save anytime: Esc → “Save game”.
tut.sick: You are sick! You need medicine — $150 at the shop. Untreated, Mike won't survive this case.
tut.meds: Medicine — $150. It cures the illness and restores health.
tut.sleep_prompt: Go to sleep? Fatigue {f}%. You will sleep about {h} h.
tut.support: The townsfolk follow the case on the news. With high support, people are more willing to help.
tut.no_gloves: You are wearing gloves — the evidence is safe.

news.title: City news
news.utilities_debt: Not enough for utilities! Debt grows.

gameover.case_closed: Seven days passed. The murder of Viktor Sokolov remains unsolved, and the case was closed. Somewhere in town, someone sleeps soundly again… but not you.
gameover.death_starved: Mike died of hunger. The investigation was left unfinished.
gameover.death_sick: The illness beat Mike. The medicine was at the shop for $150…
gameover.loan: The loan was not repaid on time. The bank took the apartment, and Mike has nowhere to live. The case remained unsolved.

ending.title: END OF CHAPTER ONE
ending.epilogue: Darkness. Cold. A voice: “You found my name. But you did not find me.” When you came to, there was only a postcard nearby: “Time is on my side, detective. See you.”
ending.thanks: Thank you for playing through the investigation!
ending.author: A game by FL1PPER
